programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An all veteran, action-packed semi-final. The house robots do not hesitate to get involved as the competitors do anything it takes to eliminate their opponents. The Loser’s Melee gives knocked out competitors a chance for redemption.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four robots from Germany, four robots from the UK. The competitors will fight their fellow compatriots for a chance to represent their country in a Germany against UK final, to decide which country has the most ferocious machine.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: 96 Robots, down to four. The Grand Final is here and the competition is fierce, only the best robot will survive and win the title of Robot Wars: The Sixth Wars champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Despite being teamed up on, a competitor manages to outsmart their opponents. Sergeant Bash gets a taste of his own medicine. The house robots play a vital role in deciding the winner of the heat finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Three axe robots meet in round one as they attempt to chop each other out of the competition. In the semi-finals Growler gets their first real taste of metal.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A competitor feels the heat of the house robots in the first round. One competitor’s weapon easily immobilizes their opponent, leaving it for the house robots to play with. Two similar robots meet in the final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight more competitors brave the Robot Wars arena. One of the robot’s attacks backfires in the semi-finals, leading to a tight final with an unexpected conclusion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer makes it to the semi-finals, will they hold their own against the veterans? Two-time World Champions and Fifth Wars Champions Razer battle first as they attempt to gain yet another title.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An all veteran, action-packed semi-final. The house robots do not hesitate to get involved as the competitors do anything it takes to eliminate their opponents. The Loser’s Melee gives knocked out competitors a chance for redemption.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: 96 Robots, down to four. The Grand Final is here and the competition is fierce, only the best robot will survive and win the title of Robot Wars: The Sixth Wars champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Another German joins the roster this week. One robot becomes an eviction technician, removing their opponents from the arena. Refbot joins the fray as he helps pit an immobilised robot.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Only one team can win the £20,000 cash prize, and they could be competing in this week’s heat. A close first round leaves it up to the judges to decide who will progress through the heat.

programme.desc: A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

programme.desc: Struggling with school? These fun and easy life hacks will change your student life! Learn how to organize your backpack in seconds, create a study schedule that actually works, and make boring supplies exciting. We show you simple DIY solutions for better note-taking and memory tricks for acing your tests. Save time, reduce stress, and make school more enjoyable with these genius tips. Perfect for students of all ages looking to work smarter, not harder.

programme.title: Easy School Hacks And Rainbow Art Ideas: Fun DIY Crafts!
programme.desc: Discover the coolest school hacks and colorful rainbow crafts in this fun creative compilation! Perfect for students looking for organization tips and artistic inspiration.

programme.title: Magical Doll Makeover: Hello Kitty, Kuromi And Barbie Transformations!
programme.desc: Watch your favorite dolls get amazing makeovers! Hello Kitty and Kuromi get stylish new looks, and Barbie becomes a magical mermaid in this fun DIY transformation story. Perfect for doll lovers and craft fans of all ages!

programme.title: Grandma And Me: Kitchen Gadgets and Parenting Hacks
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate generational cooking showdown! Watch as Grandma's classic, time-tested techniques go head-to-head with modern kitchen gadgets and clever parenting hacks. Who will win? The wisdom of tradition or the speed of innovation?

programme.title: Viral DIY Fidget Toys: Cheap And Expensive Creations!
programme.desc: Dive into the world of satisfying DIY fidget toys! Watch as we create stunning epoxy resin and nano tape creations, comparing budget-friendly vs premium results. Learn to make your own trendy accessories while enjoying fun stories behind each design. Perfect for stress relief and creative fun!

programme.title: Rich and Poor Parenting Hacks: Must-Have Gadgets and DIY Tips!
programme.desc: Who says you need to spend big to be a great parent? Watch as we compare rich vs poor parenting hacks, from high-end gadgets to clever DIY solutions that save money and time! Whether you’re splurging or saving, you’ll find tons of tips to make your life easier and your kids happier!

programme.title: Epic Food Challenge Showdown! Funny Eating And ASMR Battles
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate food challenge fun! Watch as we take on crazy eating challenges — from No Hands vs One Hand vs Two Hands to Blue vs Pink ASMR battles! It’s boys vs girls, creativity vs chaos, and laughter all the way! Who will win the ultimate food showdown?

programme.title: 3-Way Cooking Showdown: Me, Grandma and Pro
programme.desc: Get ready for the most EPIC and hilarious cooking battle ever! Who will be crowned the kitchen champion? In this wild 3-way showdown, we're pitting three completely different chefs against each other!

programme.title: Me and Grandma 100 Layers Food Challenge! Broke and Rich Cooking Battle
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate kitchen showdown! Watch as I take on Grandma in the 100 Layers Food Challenge — who will make the tastiest tower of deliciousness? From broke vs rich food hacks to crazy cooking ideas you must try, this fun and epic challenge is packed with laughs, creativity, and mouthwatering moments!

programme.title: Mystery Magic and Drink Roulette! Lucky and Unlucky
programme.desc: Get ready for a challenge where magic and mystery collide!In this epic game, we're mixing mind-blowing magic tricks with a risky mystery drink roulette! Will you get a delicious lucky sip or a gross unlucky one? The magic boxes hold the secret. Watch as we perform incredible illusions and then face the consequences of choosing the wrong box! It's a battle of skill, luck, and survival!

programme.title: Hospital Glam: Rich and Poor Beauty Hacks!
programme.desc: Who says you can't be glam in a hospital gown? We're bringing the ultimate beauty battle to the most unexpected place: the hospital! Watch as we test the most luxurious, expensive beauty products against ingenious, cheap DIY hacks, all from a hospital bed. From 5-star skincare to crafts you can make from the patient menu, these tricks will change your self-care game.

programme.title: Rich Girl’s First Day at a Poor School: Poor, Rich and Giga Rich Students!
programme.desc: When a rich girl steps into a poor school for the first time, her glamorous lifestyle shocks everyone! From luxury gadgets to creative DIY crafts, watch how rich, poor, and giga-rich students face hilarious challenges and surprising twists. Who will win the ultimate school showdown? Find out in this fun and entertaining story full of secrets, style, and school drama!

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: Memoir of a Murderer [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A former serial killer Byung-su gets diagnosed with Alzheimer’s. When a series of murders occur near his town, Byung-su gets worried whether the killings are his doings during his memory lapses. But then, he comes across Tae-ju and instinctively realizes that he's the serial killer. He reports this to the police, only to learn that Tae-ju is one. With his memory slipping, Byung-su must find a way to protect his daughter from Tae-ju.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop named Kit busts a major gangster only to find his cover blown and his main witness gone. The gangster, in retaliation, has him kidnapped and put in a Thai jail with a false criminal identity. Lowly prison guard Chai, with his extraordinary fighting skills, guards Kit and prevents his escape. The prison guard’s daughter suffers from a rare form of leukemia and Kit is the only donor who can save her. The prison guard discovers Kit’s real identity and helps him to escape in return for his agreeing to save his daughter. Together, Kit and Chai must face and take down the gangster and his minions.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6 : The Humming [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: After being appointed as the vice-principal of her alma mater, Eun-hee becomes plagued by hallucinations. Branded a troublemaker by the teachers, Ha-young hears strange sounds coming from the school's dilapidated restroom.

programme.title: Crypto Man [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Crushed by his mother's expectations, Do-hyun exploits Korea's system of privilege, from forged documents to government subsidies, culminating in his cryptocurrency ''MOMMY coin'' as scrutiny threatens his success.

programme.title: A Gilded Game [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The shortcut to the trending Asian programming you love to watch 24/7

programme.title: DETECTIVE DEE: THE FOUR HEAVENLY KINGS [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Detective Dee is forced to defend himself against the accusations of Empress Wu while investigating a crime spree.

programme.title: CHASING THE DRAGON 2: WILD WILD BUNCH [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Serial billionaire kidnapper Logan has been savaging Hong Kong. Now, his gang is aiming the dart beyond Hong Kong, at an affluent Macau regal.

programme.title: BLAZING FISTS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ikuto and Ryoma meet in juvenile detention and become best friends, they pursue their dream of participating in the martial arts event Breaking Down. However, rivalries soon turn their dreams into unexpected conflicts.

programme.title: SHAOLIN [English Dub]
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: SPECIAL ID [English Dub]
programme.desc: A cop goes undercover in a ruthless underworld organization to stop a gang leader, only to put himself in great danger after being exposed by his former protégé and best friend.

programme.title: 11 REBELS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Amidst the Boshin War's brutal conflicts, a motley squad of criminals and samurai undertakes a desperate defense of a fortress, their stand triggered by clashing interests of the Shibata clan, the shogunate, and the new government.

programme.title: THE WITCH 2: THE OTHER ONE [English Dub]
programme.desc: After escaping from a secluded laboratory, a young girl with overwhelming power finds herself on the run from several mysterious organizations, seeking refuge with a woman and her younger brother.

programme.title: Spiritwalker [English Dub]
programme.desc: With amnesia, a man shifts bodies every 12 hours, racing against time to regain memories and evade unknown threats.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: The Unrighteous [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A realistic horror film about a young man trying to protect his family from his neighbors after illegal flyers are distributed in an old villa in the suburbs, leading to a sense of unease.

programme.title: The Isle [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is a fishing resort remote from the world. The owner, Hee-jin, drops by floating houses and serves the customers: by selling them food, necessities, and sex. One day, a new customer arrives: Hyun-suk is a former detective who killed his cheating girlfriend. Hee-jin feels a bond with him and keeps watching him. That night, he tries to shoot himself, but she stops him. As some incidents happen, she develops an obsession with him. And he also finds it difficult to leave the fishing resort and her.

programme.title: Beasts Clawing at Straws [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A large bag of money appears in front of Tae-young, Jung-man, and Yeon-hee. Unexpected events occur to them chasing the bag of money, believing it to be the last chance.

programme.title: Seobok: Project Clone [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ex-agent guards the first human clone against enemies, facing a dire decision.

programme.title: SWORD MASTER [English Dub]
programme.desc: Sword Master is a martial arts action story about an elite swordsman who fakes his death to escape violence, only to be dragged back by his past. Starring Lin Gengxin, Peter Ho, Jiang Yiyan. Exhausted by endless bloodshed, a legendary master fakes his death to live in anonymity.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lee Jeong-hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su-a who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human speech and reacts to her favorite things: dancing and her grandmother’s sharp but loving flicks of the hand. Refusing to give up on her, Jeong-hwan draws on his years of experience as a tiger trainer and begins an intensive training program for his zombie daughter. A training journey more terrifying than handling a tiger and more difficult than dealing with teenage angst begins. The most heartwarming and hilarious top-secret project is about to unfold!

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
programme.desc: Mario and friends are invited to the Flower Kingdom by its ruler, Prince Florian, when Bowser suddenly appears, along with Kamek and Bowser Jr.! Bowser then takes hold of the Wonder Flower, merging himself, his Koopa Clown Car, and Prince Florian's castle to become a flying fortress, wreaking havoc across the land and trapping the Poplins in their homes. Abdallah plays as Mario and friends and sets off on a journey to defeat Bowser and save the Flower Kingdom in Super Mario Bros. Wonder on Nintendo Switch with family-friendly commentary.

Watch as Abdallah plays as Sonic and friends in Sonic Superstars on Nintendo Switch with family-friendly commentary.

programme.title: Tentacle 8
programme.desc: A mysterious computer virus wipes out highly classified personnel files at the NSA, prompting a top secret investigation. Raymond Berry, an NSA operative suspected of crimes against the United States, risks his life to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Susie's Hope
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.title: Walt Before Mickey
programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se presta a consolar a Solimar al saberla herida por causa de la ruptura de su relación amorosa con Wilker | Solimar sintiéndose devastada por la decisión de su antiguo novio se confiesa ante Yubiri al hacerla participe del gran amor que albergaba por el muchacho a pesar de su platónica relación | Yubiri se deja atemorizar por la idea de haber sido el motivo de la decisión asumida por Wilker de terminar su noviazgo con Solimar | entre tanto su amiga le lanza una advertencia.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Gladis y Marco Aurelio acuerdan que será mejor vivir separados porque cada uno extraña su soledad, pero podrán verse cada que quieran. Después, él le da la noticia a Yesenia y ella se muestra feliz al saber que Gladis se mudará de ahí.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo cancela su boda con Celia a último momento tras admitir que no la ama y que sigue dolido por Manuela. Celia, devastada y humillada, expulsa a Ricardo de su casa y acusa a Manuela de ser su verdadera enemiga, jurando venganza. Mientras tanto, María del Pilar se refugia en Gustavo tras ser plantada por Marcelo, y Margot amenaza a Benjamín Malaver para obtener seguridad. El conflicto familiar escala cuando Elizabeth confronta a su padre por su falta de honestidad emocional.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro acepta llevar el caso de la hija de Consuelo. Carmen intuye que Erasto es el secuestrador. Rosalia presiona la boda; Marisela arma escándalo a Alberto por el chantaje. Erasto, orgulloso del embarazo de Natalia, pide ayuda a Consuelo para encontrarla. Alejandro y Rosalía se casan; Marisela se aparece en plena celebración. Rosa sufre en silencio mientras Junior la consuela. Carmen jura venganza al ver el dolor de su hija. Consuelo enfrenta a Erasto exigiendo la verdad y le revela que lo denunció ante la fiscalía.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía tiene una cita con Damián. Pero se encuentra a Leo quien volvió de Europa dispuesto a recuperarla. Julio se entera del regreso de su hermano y encuentra en la licenciada Altamirano una manera de causarle problemas. Agustina le pide a Rebeca dinero de su cuenta en Suiza para ponerla a prueba. Trinidad está cansada de que Irene ayude a Leonardo. Pero él va a la casa de Irene para pedirle un favor, ya que es la única que puede resolver el problema de la empresa.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto tiene extorsionado a Anselmo, y lo usa para salir de la cárcel. Cuando ambos van a la casa de Sol, ella le dice la verdad a Heriberto sobre sus sentimientos y le confiesa que la única manera de que terminen juntos es que Alejandro sea su hermano. Reina se encuentra en la prisión con Alicia, que va para pedirle a su madre que la ayude a sacar del medio a Maricielo. A cambio de ese favor Alicia ha alterado los resultados de la prueba de ADN de Sol y Alejandro.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le da algo de plata a su hermana para que deje de desconfiar de ella. Pero Agustina sigue temiendo de lo que pueda hacer Rebeca, por lo que va a hablar con Carlos Ernesto porque quiere colaborar con la investigación y se entera de que él ya sabe sobre la infidelidad de su hermana. Irene acepta ir de viaje con Leonardo para ayudarlo a salvar a la empresa. Pero decide viajar también con Maribel para que le dé una mano con el bebé. Alejandra se enoja al enterarse del viaje de Leonardo e Irene. Leo se reencuentra con su familia. Y su regreso hace que María Lucía no se lo pueda sacar de la cabeza.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Anselmo ayuda a Heriberto a escapar de la cárcel. Heriberto visita por sorpresa a Sol en su mansión, dispuesto en llevarla a la cama. Sol da muchas vueltas con el asunto, y a pesar que le incomoda dormir con él, está segura que él es impotente y que no podrá hacerle nada. Alejandro la ve antes que se acueste, y ella le cuenta que irá a dormir con Madroño. Alejandro no puede tolerarlo, especialmente cuando el doctor Hernández lo ha llamado para citarlo y comentarle algo sobre el cotejo genético.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Botero eleva su protesta al sentirse víctima de la injusta decisión de Finita al creer a su esposa sin motivos para hacerlo pasar por la penuria de un divorcio. La familia Gamboa hace un recuento de su agotador día al haber colaborado cada uno con su aporte para hacer lucir su casa con un alegre ambiente navideño | ROKUro y Segundo se retiran de la sala al presentir la extensa conversación que advierten las mujeres de la familia al sentirse afectadas por causa del despecho asumido por Solimar.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Eden llega a casa de Pascua para hablar con ella, pero se lleva una gran sorpresa al verla llegar muy contenta con Moncho tomados de la mano. Rómulo está en el aeropuerto para irse al Orinoco, pero dentro de él espera que Egleé impida que se vaya.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia jura venganza contra Ricardo tras ser plantada. Él se refugia con la Nona, sintiéndose solo por dejar a Celia por conciencia. Hortensia, influenciada por Benjamín, planea sacar a Ricardo de las empresas, mientras Malaver busca apoderarse de todo. Brigitte causa caos con un cuchillo antes de ser llevada por Misael. Celia confronta a los Tariffi en un arranque de furia, reafirmando su amor antes de desmayarse. Ricardo enfrenta a Malaver, quien exige su fortuna y a Hortensia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo despide a Isaías en un viaje de negocios. Rosa empieza a trabajar con Junior, que aprovecha para declararle su amor. Alejandro y Rosalía celebran su luna de miel mientras ella exhibe su falso embarazo. Natalia llega a la fiesta de René en mal estado tras un aborto clandestino. Erasto descubre el escondite de Natalia, denuncia a René por el aborto y toma a Natalia como prisionera. Junior presiona a Rosa para casarse. Alejandro logra liberar a Marisela. Alberto chantajea a Rosalía hasta que Alejandro lo descubre. Consuelo y Adolfo enfrentan juntos a Erasto exigiendo la verdad.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Dos mujeres campesinas rescatan a Rosa del encierro pero la abandonan en la montaña. Alejandro y José Luis son auxiliados por una grúa. Erasto es encontrado inconsciente y robado por campesinos. Rosa lo encuentra al borde del precipicio y arriesga su propia vida para salvarlo, sin saber que es el asesino de Carlos y el secuestrador. Erasto se arrepiente del atentado contra su vida. Marisela acepta el divorcio de Adolfo y aboga por Isaías en su empresa. Consuelo niega volver con Isaías. Natalia confiesa a René que está embarazada de Erasto y pide ayuda para abortar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: René celebra su graduación como médico. Carmen Rosa exige el alta del hospital para buscar a su hija. Arminda libera a Natalia creyendo a Erasto desaparecido. José Luis publica los crímenes de Erasto en la prensa. Vilma acosa a Salvador tras su ruptura. Adolfo descubre la campaña sucia en su contra y culpa a Erasto. Natalia pide a René acabar con su embarazo. Arminda consulta las piedras y ve la muerte de Erasto, anunciándola a Consuelo. En la carretera Rosa desorientada busca ayuda; Alejandro y José Luis la auxilian sorprendidos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro y José Luis llevan a Rosa al hospital descubriendo su maltrato. Consuelo interroga a Arminda sobre la supuesta muerte de su padre. Carmen Rosa defiende a Rosa enfrentando a Blanca. Rosa convence a Alejandro de ir a rescatar a Erasto. Andreína sospecha que Alejandro y Rosa se fugaron. Junior descubre que el embarazo de Rosalía es falso y la enfrenta. Marisela desprestigia a Rosa ante Junior. Erasto recibe noticias del verdadero embarazo de Natalia y se arrepiente del plan contra Rosa. Adolfo incluye a Consuelo en sus planes futuros tras el divorcio.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro acepta llevar el caso de la hija de Consuelo. Carmen intuye que Erasto es el secuestrador. Rosalia presiona la boda; Marisela arma escándalo a Alberto por el chantaje. Erasto, orgulloso del embarazo de Natalia, pide ayuda a Consuelo para encontrarla. Alejandro y Rosalía se casan; Marisela se aparece en plena celebración. Rosa sufre en silencio mientras Junior la consuela. Carmen jura venganza al ver el dolor de su hija. Consuelo enfrenta a Erasto exigiendo la verdad y le revela que lo denunció ante la fiscalía.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo despide a Isaías en un viaje de negocios. Rosa empieza a trabajar con Junior, que aprovecha para declararle su amor. Alejandro y Rosalía celebran su luna de miel mientras ella exhibe su falso embarazo. Natalia llega a la fiesta de René en mal estado tras un aborto clandestino. Erasto descubre el escondite de Natalia, denuncia a René por el aborto y toma a Natalia como prisionera. Junior presiona a Rosa para casarse. Alejandro logra liberar a Marisela. Alberto chantajea a Rosalía hasta que Alejandro lo descubre. Consuelo y Adolfo enfrentan juntos a Erasto exigiendo la verdad.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se muestra perturbada ante la irrupción de Wilker en sus pensamientos ante el reproche de Yubiri Juan Diego se decide a acomodar lo acontecido con su frustrado compromiso para su beneficio al recordarle a Yubiri que cayo preso debido a su estadía en el barrio | Yubiri se deja halagar por la justificación de Juan Diego al retomar nuevamente su idea de haber sido la causa que permitió que el muchacho no se comprometiese | Juan Diego se aprovecha de la situación.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la oficina de producción cinematográfica Graciela recibe la llegada de Gisela quien se muestra interesada en encontrarse con el Junior para comentar el guión de la película | Graciela escudriña en sus recuerdos al intentar memorizar la cara de Gisela al esta parecerle conocida con anterioridad | Gisela por su parte se confiesa abiertamente ante Graciela al tener la misma sensación de haber conocido a la muchacha con anterioridad | Junior interrumpe la conversación entre ambas mujeres.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la oficina de Atanasio Briggite se llena de encanto para intentar explicarle a su jefe lo halagada que se siente al creerse convertida en su amante por falsos sucesos que solo ella alberga en su suposición | Atanasio guarda silencio mientras Briggite realiza el relato de la supuesta y apasionada noche que pasaron juntos | a pesar de su idea principal de intentar resolver la problemática existente en la frágil relación entre Carolina y su hijo Atanasio corrobora la versión de Briggite.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se presta a consolar a Solimar al saberla herida por causa de la ruptura de su relación amorosa con Wilker | Solimar sintiéndose devastada por la decisión de su antiguo novio se confiesa ante Yubiri al hacerla participe del gran amor que albergaba por el muchacho a pesar de su platónica relación | Yubiri se deja atemorizar por la idea de haber sido el motivo de la decisión asumida por Wilker de terminar su noviazgo con Solimar | entre tanto su amiga le lanza una advertencia.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Botero eleva su protesta al sentirse víctima de la injusta decisión de Finita al creer a su esposa sin motivos para hacerlo pasar por la penuria de un divorcio. La familia Gamboa hace un recuento de su agotador día al haber colaborado cada uno con su aporte para hacer lucir su casa con un alegre ambiente navideño | ROKUro y Segundo se retiran de la sala al presentir la extensa conversación que advierten las mujeres de la familia al sentirse afectadas por causa del despecho asumido por Solimar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska seduce a Ricardo, provocando el llanto de Manuela. En la junta, Benjamín Malaver intenta destituir a Ricardo, pero Manuela lo respalda y frustra el plan. María del Pilar es agredida y miente para protegerse. Celia invita a Moisés y su abuela a vivir con ella, enfrentando la oposición de Benjamín. Margot investiga la identidad real de Malaver. Finalmente, Manuela planea vender sus acciones para una clínica, mientras Katiuska vuelve a manipular a un confundido Ricardo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo y Manuela firman su divorcio. Ricardo entra en depresión y rechaza una fiesta organizada por Katiuska, mientras Celia celebra erróneamente creyendo que él le pedirá matrimonio. Manuela se muda al barrio y planea luchar por Glorita. Amparo, al cuidado de Moisés y la enfermera Laura Valentina, no logra comunicarse. Hortensia regresa de vacaciones y encuentra la casa en caos por los excesos de Katiuska, mientras intenta ayudar a un Ricardo que solo desea estar solo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo, deprimido tras su divorcio, decide casarse con Celia por compromiso, desatando la furia de Hortensia. Mientras la Nona lo insta a luchar por Manuela, esta última decide abandonar su vida acomodada para vivir en un barrio. Paralelamente, María del Pilar sale con Gustavo ante la ausencia de Marcelo. Juan Marcos queda impactado por la boda de su padre y recibe el llamado de Elizabeth, quien considera que las decisiones de sus padres son una locura.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo cancela su boda con Celia a último momento tras admitir que no la ama y que sigue dolido por Manuela. Celia, devastada y humillada, expulsa a Ricardo de su casa y acusa a Manuela de ser su verdadera enemiga, jurando venganza. Mientras tanto, María del Pilar se refugia en Gustavo tras ser plantada por Marcelo, y Margot amenaza a Benjamín Malaver para obtener seguridad. El conflicto familiar escala cuando Elizabeth confronta a su padre por su falta de honestidad emocional.

programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El ex Boina Verde, Justin Wise, cambia su vida de peligro por una placa de sheriff en un pueblo tranquilo en el corazón de las montañas Blue Ridge. Ahora más cerca de su ex esposa e hija, está listo para establecerse y abrazar una vida sin caos. Pero los problemas tienen una manera de seguirlo. Justo cuando comienza a adaptarse a la vida sencilla, un asesinato en la comunidad pone nerviosos a los residentes y reaviva una larga disputa entre dos de las familias más poderosas. A medida que Justin y sus ayudantes trabajan en el caso, se da cuenta de que hay más en su nuevo hogar de lo que parece. Los secretos se revelan y los motivos emergen, lo que lleva a Justin a una carrera contra el tiempo para resolver el caso antes de que la gente del pueblo tome la ley en sus propias manos.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de amor de una mujer fuerte; Serafima, quien está en un triángulo amoroso. Durante veinte años, su rival y ella han amado al mismo hombre. Además de melodrama, también muestra la vida cotidiana. Un relato sobre la historia de Rusia a través de los ojos de una persona. El destino de Serafima refleja la historia de todo el país: desde la época soviética, la perestroika, hasta la época actual.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima queda embarazada de Víctor. Tras una pelea, él es herido y ella lo cuida. Irina, la chica que Víctor ama, descubre la verdad y lo deja. Víctor y Sima se casan, pero él solo espera el nacimiento del bebé.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: El hijo de Sima nace con una grave enfermedad del corazón. Víctor la culpa. Sima busca ayuda médica en Moscú y conoce a una periodista que duda que un cirujano famoso la opere.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Irina y Víctor retoman su romance. Sima acude al cirujano Krasin por su hijo y termina salvándolo de un atentado. Agradecido, Krasin acepta operar al niño.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima permite que Irina y Víctor se vean los fines de semana. Empieza a construir su casa, mientras Irina se involucra con un gánster. Un grupo de delincuentes incendia los establos de Sima.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima pierde a su bebé y queda estéril. Irina queda embarazada de otro hombre pero miente diciendo que es de Víctor. Sima le propone divorcio a Víctor y cae en una profunda depresión.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima convence a Irina de darle el bebé a cambio de dinero. Irina se marcha, mientras Víctor planea estudiar veterinaria. Irina, en caída libre, recurre a la brujería para vengarse de Víctor, quien es diagnosticado con leucemia.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima vende sus caballos para pagar la cirugía de Víctor en Alemania. Un adicto roba el dinero y lo entrega a un traficante. Víctor huye del hospital en busca del ladrón.
